interactive.title:
Upgrade Scintilla - integrate boost's PCRE in 64 build

And remove compiling warning.

Update to Scintilla 5.6.8 & Lexilla 5.5.5

Scintilla Release 5.6.8 ( https://www.scintilla.org/scintilla568.zip )

    Released 31 October 2026.
    Improve speed by avoiding line layout when determining positions at line starts. Increase maximum size of cached lexemes from 30 to 40 as many identifiers, column names, and common values are larger than 30 bytes.
    Update case conversion and character categories to Unicode 17. Feature #1569.
    Fix crash with change history undo caused by optimizing bulk deletion in version 5.3.8.
    On Win32 fix crash and invisible text for invalid weight and stretch font settings with DirectWrite. Bug #2520.
    On Win32 when building with nmake -f scintilla.mak, move PDB file to DIR_O directory so that it is removed by nmake -f scintilla.mak clean. Bug #2521.

Lexilla Release 5.5.5 ( https://www.scintilla.org/lexilla555.zip )

    Released 31 October 2026.
    Update character categories to Unicode 17. Feature #1569.
    C++: Fix crash with incomplete preprocessor macro invocation. Issue #388.
    DMIS: Fix out-of-bounds write with long word. Issue #388, Pull request #387.
    HTML: Fix handling of HTML comments in scripts. Issue #371, Issue #338, Pull request #373.
    HTML: Allow '$', '#' and non-ASCII characters in JavaScript identifiers. Issue #371, Pull request #373.
    HTML: Support nested template literals in JavaScript. Issue #290, Pull request #373.
    HTML: Style extra type-distinguishing character in JSP and ASP tags as SCE_H_ASP. These are the '!', '#', '$', and ':' in declarations, data binding, and expressions. Issue #375.
    HTML: Do not terminate JavaScript regex literal for '/' when inside character class '[]'. Issue #377, Pull request #373.
    HTML: Recognize more language aliases including "java" and "C#" for JSP and ASP. Issue #376.
    JavaScript: Fix non-stable lexing of regex literals in both JavaScript and HTML files. Issue #374, Pull request #373.
    Julia: Fix hang for unterminated character literal at file end when lexer.julia.highlight.lexerror enabled. Issue #388, Pull request #384.
    Markdown: Recognize 'front matter' key-value metadata at file start specified in YAML, TOML or JSON. Issue #59.
    Perl: Fix hang when NUL inside here-doc. Issue #388, Pull request #389, Pull request #379.
    Perl: Fix out-of-bounds write with long here-doc delimiter with multi-byte character near limit. Stop SCE_PL_ERROR leaking past line end causing non-stable results. Issue #388, Pull request #383.
    Perl: Fix inconsistent styling of CRLF line end bytes for here-docs and formats. Issue #390.
    PHP: Style variable variable ($$variable) as SCE_HPHP_VARIABLE. Bug #2208, Pull request #373.
    PHP: Disallow DEL character in PHP identifiers. Issue #371, Pull request #373.
    Raku: Fix out-of-bounds write with long word. Issue #388, Pull request #381.
    Ruby: Fix potential out-of-bounds reads at file start. Issue #388.
    SQL: Improve performance of q-string literals. Issue #378.
    TCMD: Fix out-of-bounds write with long word. Issue #388, Pull request #386.
    TeX: Fix out-of-bounds write with long command. Issue #388, Pull request #382.
    Visual Prolog: Fix crash with deep nesting. Issue #388, Pull request #380.
    X12: Fix read into empty allocation. Issue #388, Pull request #385.

Close #18588

Update to Scintilla 5.6.5 & Lexilla 5.5.2

Scintilla Release 5.6.5 ( https://www.scintilla.org/scintilla565.zip )

    Released 4 August 2026.
    Add SC_UPDATE_TEXT and SC_UPDATE_LINE_COUNT flags to SCN_UPDATEUI notifications. This can help improve performance by client code switching from listening for changes with rapid SCN_MODIFIED to delayed SCN_UPDATEUI notifications.
    On Qt, prepare for drawing asynchronously to avoid styling inside the draw handler. This may improve performance and matches other platforms.
    On Cocoa, fix problem where styling and update UI notifications were performed inside drawing instead of before drawing which could cause drawing to be abandoned unnecessarily.
    Increase interior width of MarkerSymbol::Plus and Minus to match stroke width setting.
    Improve performance of fold discovery in some situations by styling progressively larger blocks of lines.
    Don't use std::async and std::future in single threaded situations. This avoids crashes with some runtime libraries as well as minor performance costs. Geany Issue #4620.

Lexilla Release 5.5.2 ( https://www.scintilla.org/lexilla552.zip )

    Released 4 August 2026.
    JavaScript: in cpp, XML, and HTML lexers, only recognize regular expression literal when initial '/' is followed by another '/' on the same line.
    Lexilla may be built without exporting any entry points by defining the preprocessor symbol LEXILLA_NO_EXPORT. This is only useful when building a static library. Issue #311.

Close #18280

Scintilla Release 5.6.5 ( https://www.scintilla.org/scintilla565.zip )

    Released 4 August 2026.
    Add SC_UPDATE_TEXT and SC_UPDATE_LINE_COUNT flags to SCN_UPDATEUI notifications. This can help improve performance by client code switching from listening for changes with rapid SCN_MODIFIED to delayed SCN_UPDATEUI notifications.
    On Qt, prepare for drawing asynchronously to avoid styling inside the draw handler. This may improve performance and matches other platforms.
    On Cocoa, fix problem where styling and update UI notifications were performed inside drawing instead of before drawing which could cause drawing to be abandoned unnecessarily.
    Increase interior width of MarkerSymbol::Plus and Minus to match stroke width setting.
    Improve performance of fold discovery in some situations by styling progressively larger blocks of lines.
    Don't use std::async and std::future in single threaded situations. This avoids crashes with some runtime libraries as well as minor performance costs. Geany Issue #4620.
